title: DRAGON BALL Z
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Nine seasons and 291 episodes from Raditz to Kid Buu, charted season by season: every saga and sub-arc, every transformation and the episode it lands in, the Z Fighters' shifting pecking order, and — because you asked — where the anime-only filler is.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Goku, Gohan, Vegeta, Piccolo, Krillin, Bulma, Trunks, Goten and the rest of the Z Fighters — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast as TVmaze credits it, which for an anime means the villains, the one-arc allies and the voice cast behind them.
chartHint: Nine seasons across, split the way the sagas were. Click any bar to filter the episode list; arcs that start mid-season have the exact episode in the label.
credits: Episode data, images and ratings from TVmaze (English broadcast titles). Chart hand-built from the series.
